run_llm_generate_reproducibility: run vLLM LLM.generate() with SamplingParams to produce reproducible text generation outputs
create_sampling_params: create a SamplingParams object with temperature and top_p for deterministic text generation
build_llm_instance: build an LLM instance from vLLM with a specified model for offline inference
test_reproducibility_environment: test vLLM reproducibility by setting VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT and VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING environment variables
summarize_generate_outputs: summarize LLM generate outputs by iterating over results and extracting prompt and generated text
